integrity: The source finite-dimensional inequalities and convexity premise were independently checked in the primary full text. The remaining optimization is reduced to one variable; exact rational Sturm certificates isolate the only relevant crossing and derivative zero. Decimal values are display approximations only.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a rigorous four-dimensional upper bound by exactly optimizing the two finite-dimensional spectral inequalities from the source. It does not determine the exact four-dimensional extremal constant, does not assert that the cone family is extremal in dimension four, and does not optimize other dimensions.
title: An exact four-dimensional spectral bound for Khachiyan central cuts
